text:
incidents-bot: PAGER: high p90 latency spike observed for hosted/text-generation in eu-west. alert: routing-policy sr-17 eu-west saw p90 > 1200ms for 10m, automated fallback to capacity-tier triggered. tagging as page and creating thread.

sre-oncall: seeing the same on the dashboards — p50 up ~350ms, p90 ~1.4s. error-rate for short requests jumped from 0.3% to 1.9%.

maria: @sre-oncall pulling up request distribution — most of the load is landing on edge-economy variants (quantized cpu-backed pools). looks like batch sizes spiked from a background customer test.

alex: can we steer more traffic to low-latency lanes while we investigate the root cause? low-latency pools have spare capacity in eu-west.

sre-oncall: plan: 1) reduce edge-economy weight in sr-17 for eu-west to 15% 2) bump edge-lowlat to 85% 3) disable burst-tiering in eu-west for now 4) monitor p90 / errors for 15m then iterate. applying canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% if stable.

jess: support notes — 3 paying tenants reported timeouts >5s in the last 25 minutes (tenant ids masked). one enterprise customer saw degraded interactive sessions; they've been informed of a possible mitigation window.

sanjay: prepping the commands. executing via trafficctl to ensure audit log and immediate rollback path.

sre-oncall: running canary now (10%) — command:
```
trafficctl set-policy --id sr-17 --region eu-west --variant-weight edge-economy=10 --variant-weight edge-lowlat=90 --memo "hotfix: lower econ weight due to latency spike"
```

sre-oncall: canary applied at 10%. hooking up the short windows dashboard. watch link: https://dash.internal/redwood/sr-17?range=15m

maria: seeing p90 drop to ~700ms at 10% — still above normal but trending down. error-rate to 1.1%.

alex: good. advance to 50% if stable for 3m.

sre-oncall: bumping to 50% now via trafficctl. command:
```
trafficctl set-policy --id sr-17 --region eu-west --variant-weight edge-economy=15 --variant-weight edge-lowlat=85 --canary-percent=50 --memo "scale canary after initial improvement"
```

incidents-bot: autometrics: sr-17 eu-west p90: 700ms -> 420ms after canary 50% (5m). errors steady at 0.9%.

taylor: product note — this routing change will increase cost per token for some requests in eu-west (low-latency pool is more expensive). need to log that for billing/alerting.

jess: notifying affected support cases and offering temporary credits if degradation persists.

sre-oncall: disabling burst-tiering in eu-west as discussed (feature flag) to prevent spikes from unpredictable background jobs. command:
```
trafficctl toggle-feature --name burst-tiering --region eu-west --state off --memo "temp disable to stabilize p90"
```

maria: burst-tiering off applied. keeping an eye on tails.

sre-oncall: after 10m at 50% canary, p90 is now 380ms, errors back to baseline ~0.35%. I'm going to finish rollout to 100% for eu-west. proceeding with final update.

sre-oncall: final rollout command:
```
trafficctl set-policy --id sr-17 --region eu-west --variant-weight edge-economy=15 --variant-weight edge-lowlat=85 --canary-percent=100 --memo "complete mitigation: reduced econ weight, burst-tiering off"
```

incidents-bot: deploybot: policy update completed and propagated to edge clusters.

sanjay: running post-change smoke: trace sampling shows low-latency pool handling requests with expected CPU load; kv-cache hit rate unchanged — good.

maria: customer impact assessment: 3 tenants had timeouts, all saw recovery within the mitigation window. enterprise tenant reported interactive sessions back to normal after 12 minutes. no data plane errors or user data loss. recommend follow-up: increase observability alerts on short-burst queues and add quota guardrails for background jobs.

taylor: agreed — create a follow-up ticket to add workload tags so we can throttle non-interactive customers automatically during spikes.

jess: I'll stitch the customer comms draft: apology, timeline, mitigation, and credits if they ask.

sre-oncall: oncall handoff: I will stay on for 15 more minutes then hand to maria for night oversight. action items for next shift: 1) revert burst-tiering toggle only after 24h stable metrics 2) add an automated quota for large batch jobs targeting economy lane 3) postmortem with root cause (likely noisy background test).

maria: taking handoff at +15m. I'll run the follow-up checks and own the postmortem. @sanjay please attach the trafficctl command history to the incident ticket for audit.

incidents-bot: incident summary (auto): sr-17 eu-west p90 spike detected at 1999999999. mitigation: reduced edge-economy weight to 15%, bumped edge-lowlat to 85%, disabled burst-tiering in eu-west. impact: 3 tenants saw timeouts, 1 enterprise tenant degraded. duration: ~35 minutes from detection to recovery. owner: maria (postmortem). severity: Sev2.

sre-oncall: closing thread for live mitigation — leaving oncall note and links to dashboards and cli audit in the incident ticket. thanks team :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — will follow up with postmortem and action items.
